prerequisites: Students must have passed at least 168 credits.
Students must have an internship offer signed by the company and accepted by the Center's Directorate.

learning_outcomes.text: Demonstrate capacity for analysis and synthesis
Demonstrate skills for planning, organization, and strategy
Acquire the capacity for effective problem-solving
Develop the capacity to transmit information, ideas, problems, and solutions to an audience, both specialized and non-specialized
Skill in information search and management
Skill to work in an international context
Capacity to work in an interdisciplinary team

Capacity for the drafting and development of projects in the field of mechanical engineering, for the construction, renovation, repair, conservation, demolition, manufacturing, installation, assembly, or operation of: structures, mechanical equipment, energy installations, electrical installations, industrial installations and plants, and manufacturing processes.
Specific competencies are determined by the nature of the company internships; the set of internships must cover all competencies.
Obtain a first practical experience using the acquired capacities in a real environment.
Student adaptation to the professional world.

assessment_methods.method: Participation in tutoring sessions (Academic Tutor's Report)

assessment_rules: The final grade is composed of an interim monitoring report (40%), a final justifying report (40%), and participation in tutoring sessions (20%). The syllabus does not specify minimum marks for passing components or resit arrangements.
